pages.text: Put a frame on the $(item)Assembly Gantry$(), fit modules in the slots of the right kind and press Assemble. The $(l)Hopper$() is light, the $(l)Bulwark$() tough, the $(l)Wheelhouse$() a car, the $(l)Skitter$() climbs walls, the $(l)Kite$() flies and the $(l)Colossus$() carries shoulder weapons.
The $(l)Chimera$() has three Gene Ports and the $(l)Executive$() four. Weight against the load rating sets your speed; heat past the cap vents the mecha; an empty battery means limp mode.
